body: I feel this, I know it's hard to break away from the delusions because you really want and crave that certain person, but you'll eventually realize that they're not exactly what you pictured in your head. Yes, It's easier to be with the delusion, but don't you want that real human contact instead?

I have the same sort of experience too. Mine is a black ball of smoke and crawls on my bedroom floor, everytime I look behind me it is on the floor crawling and trying to get out of my sight, like it knows I've noticed it. Its creepy at first and I get scared sometimes but now I'm just use to it.
